'''2010 Canadian Nationals Stephen Kim LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Kim]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Two R... Mounties
* '''Username:''' vaith
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
